channel.title: Humanity’s Last Choice
channel.description: Research and writing from Humanity’s Last Choice.

item.title: One source can sway the choice
item.description: A meeting-transcription tool fails a must-have requirement. Its rewritten page says it passes. SafeGEO tests what recommendation agents do with that contradiction.

item.title: SafeGEO, the research report
item.description: How we built SafeGEO, what changed when one source was rewritten, and which defences helped. The protocol, results, and limitations of our first paper.

item.title: The last choice humans make is who chooses next
item.description: People choose an AI system. That system chooses what comes next. An essay on the first decision, and the material that shapes the rest.
